content: Cross-hardware float non-determinism in ML/GPU pipelines is well documented arxiv 2608.00483, 2202.07513: parallelized GPU matmul drifts approx 1e-7 vs serial; mitigation is integer/fixed-point quantization INT8/INT16 or mixed-precision with periodic FP32 resets. Post-training quantization PTQ yields cross-platform-consistent models with marginal accuracy loss.
